Beef chuck braised slowly with potato, carrot and onion in a rich tomato and stout gravy, ladled thick into bowls with crusty bread and butter. Toss 1.2kg diced beef chuck in 2 tbsp flour and brown in batches in oil. Cook 2 onions and 3 garlic cloves for 5 minutes, add 2 tbsp tomato paste, then 375ml stout, 500ml beef stock, thyme and bay. Return the beef, cover and cook at 160C for 2 hours. Add 600g potatoes and 3 carrots in chunks and cook 45 minutes more until tender. Season and serve with crusty bread and butter.
W: Bloom gelatine leaves in cold water, dissolve in warm raspberry purée sweetened with sugar and a squeeze of lemon, strain, pour into shallow glass dishes and set 4 hours. Fresh raspberries on top.
MacReady's Scotch, shared at the end, in a lolly

Soft butter caramels cooked with cream and golden syrup, finished with a splash of Scotch and a pinch of flaky salt, wrapped in baking paper. Line a 20cm square tin with baking paper. Put 200g caster sugar, 250ml cream, 80g butter and 80g golden syrup in a heavy saucepan and stir over medium heat until dissolved. Boil without stirring until it reaches 120C on a thermometer, about 15 minutes. Take off the heat, stir in 30ml Scotch and half a tsp salt, and pour into the tin. Sprinkle with flaky salt, cool 3 hours, cut into squares and wrap in paper.
K: Blended Scotch, sweet vermouth and bitters stirred cold

Blended Scotch stirred with sweet vermouth and bitters over ice until silky cold, strained into chilled glasses with a cocktail cherry, blood red. Chill 4 coupe or rocks glasses. For each drink, stir 60ml blended Scotch, 25ml sweet red vermouth and 2 dashes aromatic bitters with plenty of ice in a jug for 20 seconds. Strain into the glasses and drop in a cocktail cherry. Totals are 240ml Scotch, 100ml vermouth and 4 cherries. Serve over one big ice block for anyone who likes it on the rocks.

s.note: Corn chips baked with black beans, cheddar and jalapeños
s.how: Spread 300g corn chips over a large oven tray. Scatter over a 400g tin of drained black beans, 200g grated cheddar and 2 sliced jalapeños. Bake at 200C for 8 minutes until the cheese melts. Top with 150g sour cream and 150g salsa and serve straight from the tray.

s.note: Thick white toast spread with salted butter right to the crusts
s.how: Toast 8 slices thick white bread until deep golden. Spread each straight away with salted butter right to the crusts, about 80g in total, so it melts in. Cut into soldiers and pile on a warm plate.

m.note: Slow cooked beef chuck chilli with chipotle and cumin
m.how: Cut 1kg beef chuck into chunks and brown in batches. Soften 2 diced brown onions and 3 garlic cloves, add 2 tbsp chipotle in adobo, 2 tsp ground cumin, 800g crushed tomatoes, a 400g tin kidney beans and the beef. Cover and braise at 160C for 2.5 hours. Bake a 350g cornbread mix as the packet says and serve alongside.

w.how: Soak 5 gelatine leaves in cold water for 5 minutes. Blitz 300g raspberries with 100g caster sugar and 300ml water, warm until steaming and strain. Squeeze the gelatine dry and stir into the hot purée with the juice of half a lemon. Pour into four shallow glass dishes and set in the fridge for 4 hours. Top with 125g fresh raspberries.

d.note: Blended Scotch, sweet vermouth and bitters stirred cold
d.how: Chill 4 coupe or rocks glasses. For each drink, stir 60ml blended Scotch, 25ml sweet red vermouth and 2 dashes aromatic bitters with plenty of ice in a jug for 20 seconds. Strain into the glasses and drop in a cocktail cherry. Totals are 240ml Scotch, 100ml vermouth and 4 cherries. Serve over one big ice block for anyone who likes it on the rocks.
